hypothesis: deepfm_mtl_focal_v1 regressed because focal_gamma=2.0 was overly aggressive in down-weighting well-classified negatives on highly imbalanced recommendation signals. Relaxing focal_gamma to 1.0 with aux_weight=0.1 will softly focus gradient updates on hard impression pairs without destabilizing the multi-task embedding representations established in deepfm_mtl_v1.
